title: Type soundness for labelled Imp by strengthening to statement-and-throw security
intent: Prove type soundness of the labelled Imp system (`well_typed_stmt s pc -> secure_stmt s pc`) by first strengthening the goal with `enough` to the conjunction `secure_stmt s pc /\ secure_throw_stmt s pc`, then inducting on the typing derivation so each of the eight statement constructors is closed by the per-constructor lemma (and its throw twin) proved earlier in the file.

applicability.goal_shape: A soundness statement `well_typed P -> secure P` over an inductively defined typing relation, where the target property has two paired forms — normal termination (`secure_stmt`) and exceptional termination (`secure_throw_stmt`) — that must be proved in lockstep.
applicability.use_when: Each constructor of the typing relation already has a matching per-constructor lemma for each of the two forms; strengthening the goal to their conjunction lets a single induction on the typing derivation cover both forms at once, so the extra conjunct costs nothing per case. The strengthened goal must be dischargeable back to the original (here `try tauto`).
applicability.avoid_when: The two forms cannot be discharged by paired per-constructor lemmas (or one form is not actually needed — then the strengthening over-proves); the induction is not on the typing derivation itself; or the strengthened conjunct is not recoverable from the original goal, so `enough` leaves a residual obligation.

consequences: The move turns one soundness goal into eight constructor goals, each a pair (normal and throw). Obligations: every constructor needs both a secure_stmt and a secure_throw_stmt lemma — the two never collapse — and the strengthened conjunct must be recoverable from the original goal (`try tauto`). The While and TryCatch cases destruct their induction hypotheses to reach the throw form, which is exactly why the strengthening is needed: induction on the typing derivation alone would not produce it. Failure mode: strengthening to a conjunction that is not strong enough for the recursive constructors leaves the induction stuck; strengthening too much (a form no constructor needs) over-proves.
